name: Eris
source:
Careless to the extreme, she has never succeeded in anything she has attempted. She is introverted and gets saddened easily, but is obedient and is sure to lend an ear to what others have to say. An apprentice demon who is tagging  along with [url=/c82194]Alcon[/url].

[Translated from [url=https://www.saibunkan.co.jp/scramble/jin/rena/other.html]Scramble HOUSE's official website[/url]]
